items.title: PHP Remote Code Execution Vulnerabilities (PHP2Shell)
items.summary: Two remote code execution bugs in PHP (PHP2Shell) affect PHP 5.4 and later, including Magento stores, allowing unauthenticated code execution under specific server conditions.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-153
items.summary: This update addresses critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities, including a template engine injection (CVE-2026-103849, "BlockStrap") that allows unauthenticated arbitrary code execution.

items.title: BlockStrap: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution via Template Engine Injection
items.summary: A critical template engine injection vulnerability (BlockStrap) allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on Magento and Adobe Commerce servers.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201) and several incorrect authorization flaws, with six exploitable without authentication.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146
items.summary: This critical security update resolves a vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650, "StyleSmuggler") that could result in arbitrary code execution and is being exploited in the wild.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (0-day exploited in the wild)
items.summary: A critical zero-day RCE vulnerability (StyleSmuggler) in Magento and Adobe Commerce was actively exploited in the wild, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362) and two stored cross-site scripting flaws.
